name: Smart Button [Milesight]
description: Milesight WS101 smart button (codec ws101-decoder.js, fPort 85): `button_event.status` is 'short press' / 'long press' / 'double press', sent once per press; `battery` is a percentage (not volts), so the standard volt-based battery alarms do not apply; `button_battery` alerts below 20 % (param `batt_low_pct`). Transparent fire-only rule (`pulse`): every press of any kind raises one notification, nothing latches and nothing is ever cleared. Frames that carry no press (battery, status) change nothing.
